description: Semantic role map for TREC 39-11 (Amendment to Contract). MODE-A-ONLY MAP built 2026-09-08 (Carter): contains ONLY the party signing widgets (signatures + footer initials) — deal/property fields are not mapped here (the fill engine handles them via its own field maps). Coordinates extracted from the live AcroForm widget rects (pdf-lib, same method as the 2026-09-02 role-map batch); party assignment derived by rendering the page and reading the printed labels, NOT from AcroForm field names. x_pct/y_pct/w_pct/h_pct are top-left-origin percentages 0-100. DATE PLACEMENT CHECKED AND REJECTED 2026-09-21 (Carter, per Cole review): the only printed date-shaped blank on this page is the single EXECUTED-the-___-day-of block above the signature rows — a broker-filled contract-wide effective/final-acceptance date, not a per-signer signing date, and physically one blank (mapping it to all 4 signers would violate the build scripts own no-shared-rect check and put 4 different dates in one box on an executed instrument). Row1-to-row2 vertical gap (~0.014 of page height) is also too tight for any synthetic per-signer date box without touching the next rows printed text (rendered + visually confirmed at multiple offsets). Left refusing on purpose.
